instruction: Candid action photograph, full shot. In an open grassy field, the man in the blue plaid shirt and black pants (R1) lifts and spins the woman in the white long-sleeve top and white pants (R2) in his arms. The woman (R2) wraps her arms around his neck, smiling joyfully as her legs lift off the ground. Strong golden hour sun flare from behind the trees creates a warm, hazy glow.
